The '''Orto Plutonia clone security force''' was a [[clone trooper]] [[garrison]] that occupied the [[planet]] [[Orto Plutonia]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. As leader of the [[Pantoran Assembly|government]] of [[Pantora]], [[Chairman]] [[Chi Cho]] petitioned the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] to support the [[Pantoran]]s' claim of sovereignty over Orto Plutonia. Having chosen to oblige the Chairman's request, [[Glid Station]] was constructed to house a detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] until a nearby [[Talz village]] was provoked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Confederacy military|forces]], resulting in a [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia|skirmish]] that destroyed the [[Cloning|clone]] security force.<ref name="Trespass" />

After the [[Jedi Order]] lost all contact with the security force, [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], the [[501st Legion]], and a delegation from Pantora that included Cho and [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]], were dispatched to investigate. Their findings led to the discovery of the [[Talz]] village and a meeting was set up with their [[High Council (Talz)|High Council]]. Cho regarded the [[Homeworld|native]] Talz as savages that had no claim on Orto Plutonia, and seeking to reinforce his government's own claim on the planet, provoked a [[One-Day War|war]] between the Talz and Pantora. The conflict ultimately ended with the Chairman's [[death]] and a peace agreement after the [[Speaker of the Assembly]] had called Cho's actions out of order.<ref name="Trespass" />

The clone [[trooper]]s of the security force were equipped with light gray [[Phase I clone trooper armor|phase I armor]] and pale blue markings. Their outpost had a [[hangar]] that stored [[BARC speeder]]s and [[CK-6 swoop bike]]s<ref name="Trespass" />
